name: Greave Bash
description: Kick with a shin armoured in bone and smash it into the target's knee or thigh.

name: Gorget Rise
description: Raise a collar of bone about the throat and jaw to turn a cut aimed at the neck.

name: Cuirass Draw
description: Draw bone qi across the chest until a close fitting cuirass of plates stands over the ribs.

name: Pauldron Turn
description: Roll the shoulder plate up under a falling blade and send the edge over the top.

name: Plated Surge
description: Surge forward behind the plates and strike with the whole armoured shoulder in one motion.

name: Plate Crash
description: Crash the armoured forearm down on the target's guard and break the line of their weapon.

name: Full Carapace
description: Close plate over plate across the whole body into a single shell that turns heavy blows.

name: Shattering Carapace
description: Burst the shell outward in a ring of flung plates that strike every foe about the user.

name: Splinter Flick
description: Flick a thin splinter from a fingertip bone so it stings a foe a few paces off.

name: Fracture Ward
description: Pre-crack the outer layer of the bone so it gives under a blow and spares the core.

name: Burst Sense
description: Feel the tension in a bone and judge how near it stands to bursting.

name: Brittle Draw
description: Draw the bone qi tight so that the next break throws its splinters with greater force.

name: Splinter Spray
description: Burst a handful of splinters from the palm in a fan that pricks every foe in front.

name: Shard Pin
description: Pin the target's sleeve or cloak to the ground with a thrown shard of bone.

name: Cracking Strike
description: Strike so the blow itself cracks the bone and sprays shards into the target's flesh.

name: Fracture Burst
description: Shatter a limb's bone from inside and cast the splinters out in a wide cutting storm.

name: Shard Bloom
description: Seed shards in the air round the foes over several breaths and let them all burst open together.

name: Matched Whips
description: Lash both bone whips across the target from either side so the guard cannot cover both.

name: Pair Brace
description: Cross the two whips before the body in a braced pair and take a heavy blow on the cross.

name: Twin Reckon
description: Trail the pair along the ground and read from their two touches how a space is laid out.

name: Paired Step
description: Plant both whips and vault the body forward to land a long pace beyond the foe's reach.

name: Mirror Lash
description: Send one whip high and one low in mirrored arcs so the guard answers one and misses the other.

name: Doubled Coil
description: Coil both whips round the target in opposite turns and draw them tight to hold fast.

name: Paired Spines
description: Strike with one whip and guard with the other and swap their work between breaths.

name: Spine Cascade
description: Whirl both whips in rapid crossing arcs that cut a wide circle about the user.

name: Femur Hammer
description: Swing the thigh bone up into a low kick with the weight of a hammer behind it.

name: Thigh Pillar
description: Set both thigh bones as upright pillars under the body to take a heavy blow without sinking.

name: Stride Pair
description: Take two long strides in quick pairs with the leg bones locked and the weight carried clear.

name: Long Bone Sense
description: Press both feet to the ground and feel through the long bones what moves around.

name: Pair Draw
description: Draw qi down both thigh bones together until the legs stand matched in strength.

name: Hammer Pair
description: Kick with one leg and follow at once with the other so the second blow lands on the first.

name: Pillar Lock
description: Clamp the target's leg between both thigh bones in a vice and hold it still.

name: Sweeping Shin
description: Sweep the shin low along the ground and take the target's footing from under them.

name: Femur Fall
description: Bring the whole thigh down like a felled beam on the target's guard and crush it.

name: Pillar Crush
description: Plant both pillars on the target and bear down until they are held to the ground.

name: Sworn Marrow
description: Swear the oath inwardly and let it settle into the marrow as a fixed warmth.

name: Vow Rib
description: Let the ribs hold to the oath so a heavy blow finds the chest as unyielding as a pledge.

name: Sworn Knuckle
description: Punch with a knuckle sworn to the word given and let the blow carry its full weight.

name: Bearing Feel
description: Feel through the bones for the lean of the ground and the heading of the wind.

name: Standing Oath
description: Stand on the oath with the frame locked so every blow on it is met and steadied.

name: Binding Marrow
description: Send a bound line of bone qi into the target's limb so the marrow locks fast to the vow.

name: Oathbone Strike
description: Strike with every bone sworn to a single blow that breaks what it was sworn against.

name: Unyielding Vow
description: Hold the oath through the whole frame so that no blow or gust of qi moves the user a pace.

name: Standing Bone
description: Set the spine upright and every joint under it so a shove runs down into the ground.

name: Dropping Fist
description: Drop the whole weight straight down the frame into a fist driven on a true vertical.

name: Tilt Sense
description: Feel through the feet for any tilt in the ground or lean in the foe.

name: Steady Spine
description: Straighten the spine with a slow draw of qi so every stroke starts from the same centre.

name: Plumb Press
description: Press straight down on the target's shoulders through the frame until their knees begin to bend.

name: Anchored Stance
description: Anchor the stance and hook a grasping foe so they cannot pull away or push through.

name: Kneeling Break
description: Drive a heel into the side of the knee and fold the target's leg beneath them.

name: Immovable Bone
description: Make the whole frame one piece of bone that nothing short of a siege blow can shift.

name: Toppling Strike
description: Strike from the anchored stance so the blow drives the target off their feet and onto their back.
